newsitem.title: USA: Applied Analytical sees charge from buy.
newsitem.headline: Applied Analytical sees charge from buy.

text.p: Applied Analytical Industries Inc said Thursday that it has exercised its option to acquire a German research and development company for about $18 million.

The company said the acquisition of L.A.B. Gesellschaft fur pharmakologische Untersuchungen mbH & Co should be "modestly accretive" to its 1997 earnings and result in a one-time charge for an as-yet undetermined amount.
L.A.B. focuses on pharmaceutical product development such as Phase I clinical studies and bioanalytical testing. It has about 250 employees, Applied Analytical said.
